source.name: S&P 500 (S&P Dow Jones Indices) deflated by CPI-U (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics)
source.method: Real level = month-end close x CPI(latest month) / CPI(that month); a month with no CPI print (months after the latest release, and October 2025) uses the most recent earlier print. Annual real return = (1 + nominal return) / (1 + December-to-December CPI change) - 1.
source.totalReturn: S&P 500 with dividends reinvested: Damodaran (NYU Stern) 1928-1987, S&P 500 Total Return index 1988 on
source.cpi: CPI-U, all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted (CUUR0000SA0)
